subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Grubbs catalyst, 1st generation（RuCl₂(PCy₃)₂(=CHPh)）？
A. Square pyramidal
B. Trigonal bipyramidal
C. Trigonal prismatic
D. Octahedral
explanation: Square pyramidal. Covalent count: Ru (group 8) 8 e; 1 × =CHPh (L) 2 e; 2 × PCy₃ (L) 4 e; 2 × Cl (X) 2 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −2 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Ru(II), d⁶; d⁶ + 10 e from the ligands = 16 e. The benzylidene is counted as a neutral 2-electron carbene, so ruthenium is Ru(II).
